recipes.title: Kimchi Carbonara
recipes.description: Roman carbonara meets Korean kimchi: silky egg-yolk sauce, smoky bacon and a tangy, spicy crunch.

recipes.title: Banh Mi Meatball Baguettes
recipes.description: Italian-style pork meatballs seasoned with fish sauce and lemongrass, stuffed into baguettes with Vietnamese pickled carrot and daikon, cilantro, chili and a swipe of mayo.

recipes.title: Dan Dan Bolognese
recipes.description: A Sichuan dan dan meat sauce cooked like a weeknight Bolognese: browned pork, doubanjiang and sesame, tossed with pappardelle and finished with cucumber and peanuts.

recipes.title: Miso Butter Tacos
recipes.description: Japanese miso butter meets a Mexican taco night: roasted sweet potatoes glazed in salty-sweet miso butter, tucked into warm corn tortillas with lime cabbage.

recipes.title: Tikka Masala Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: A British shepherd's pie with an Indian tikka masala filling: spiced chicken simmered in a tomato-butter sauce, baked under a blanket of buttery mashed potatoes.
